The darknet signal counts unsolicited traffic reaching the Merit Network Telescope, not traffic people send or receive. z-score -1.59 against the same 7 days. BGP held steady, so this reads as a single-source dip (BO-IND-4), not a confirmed outage. Other measurers in this country within 24 h: Cloudflare Radar 0 outages and 0 verified anomalies; NetBlocks 0 posts. Exposure, an upper bound and not users affected: about 31 million people online in Ukraine (ITU 2024: 82.5% of 38 million). Access Now's STOP sheet lists 4 shutdowns here in 2025 (stated causes: conflict, other), the latest starting 2025-12-12; history only, not evidence about this outage.
